canada-dnd-valcartier.st: Active Canadian Army support base and training area. The official base page says the Valcartier assembly camp first opened in 1914 and that the site now hosts 2nd Canadian Division Support Group and 5 CMBG. A National Defence November 2024 briefing listed 'Trichloroethylene (TCE) Contamination, CFB Valcartier' among six 2024/2025 high-priority Federal Contaminated Sites Action Plan remediation projects. IAAC registry 90825 (Combat Course Phase 2 / Termoli Range) had a public comment period from 7 to 27 October 2026; as of the page checked on 2026-11-23 the comment period was closed, the assessment status was 'In progress', and no determination had been posted. No open comment period was found on that date.
canada-dnd-valcartier.what: Coordinates are the official NRCan CGNDB military feature 'Canadian Forces Base/Area Support Unit Valcartier' (ESFQU), not a surveyed footprint of the Termoli Range or the TCE project. The TCE listing is a contaminated-sites remediation project; the official briefing does not describe it as a munitions or UXO incident. Contact information on the IAAC page uses a Real Property Operations Detachment Valcartier address in Courcelette, Quebec.
